where.if: and (message_id like concat('%',#{query.keyword},'%') or message_name like concat('%',#{query.keyword},'%') or source_process_definition_key like concat('%',#{query.keyword},'%') or target_process_definition_key like concat('%',#{query.keyword},'%') or correlation_key like concat('%',#{query.keyword},'%'))

mapper.select:
select from wf_collaboration_message
order by create_time desc, message_id desc limit #{pageSize} offset #{offset}
select from wf_collaboration_message where message_id=#{messageId} for update

select from wf_collaboration_message current_message where current_message.status='RETRYING' and current_message.next_attempt_time <= current_timestamp(3) and current_message.sequence_no=(select channel.inbound_sequence+1 from wf_collaboration_channel channel where channel.channel_id=current_message.channel_id) order by current_message.next_attempt_time,current_message.create_time,current_message.message_id limit 1 for update skip locked
mapper.update: update wf_collaboration_message set matched_process_instance_id=#{matchedProcessInstanceId},target_execution_id=#{targetExecutionId},status='PROCESSED',attempt_count=#{attemptCount},complete_time=current_timestamp(3),next_attempt_time=null,last_error_code=null,last_error_summary=null,revision_no=revision_no+1 where message_id=#{messageId} and status in ('RECEIVED','RETRYING')

update wf_collaboration_message set status='RETRYING',attempt_count=#{attemptCount},last_error_code=#{lastErrorCode},last_error_summary=#{lastErrorSummary},next_attempt_time=date_add(current_timestamp(3), interval least(300,power(2,least(#{attemptCount},8))) second),revision_no=revision_no+1 where message_id=#{messageId} and status in ('RECEIVED','RETRYING')

update wf_collaboration_message set status='DEAD_LETTER',attempt_count=#{attemptCount},last_error_code=#{lastErrorCode},last_error_summary=#{lastErrorSummary},complete_time=current_timestamp(3),next_attempt_time=null,revision_no=revision_no+1 where message_id=#{messageId} and status in ('RECEIVED','RETRYING')

update wf_collaboration_message set status='RETRYING',attempt_count=0,compensation_count=compensation_count+1,complete_time=null,next_attempt_time=current_timestamp(3),last_error_code=null,last_error_summary=null,revision_no=revision_no+1 where message_id=#{messageId} and status='DEAD_LETTER' and revision_no=#{revisionNo}

update wf_collaboration_message set status='RETRYING',last_error_code='COLLAB_MESSAGE_OUT_OF_ORDER',last_error_summary='等待前序协作消息',next_attempt_time=date_add(current_timestamp(3), interval 1 second),revision_no=revision_no+1 where message_id=#{messageId} and status='RECEIVED'
mapper.delete: delete from wf_collaboration_message_audit where direction='INBOUND' and message_id in #{messageId}
mapper.select: select min(complete_time) from wf_collaboration_message where status='PROCESSED' and complete_time is not null
